data.gender_notes: Kaustubh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kaustubh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kaustubha', which means 'golden tummo' or 'auspicious'. In Hindu mythology, Kaustubh is known as the sacred gem worn by Lord Vishnu. It is believed that this gem bestows the wearer with good fortune, prosperity, and protection. The name Kaustubh carries the meaning “Golden Tummo, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kaustubh usually hope their child will grow to embody golden tummo, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
